name: Standard Sales Order Processing - Route to Create Order
trigger: Inbound SOAP request containing standard sales order notification (e.g. OrderTypeCode YORB)
expected_outcome: HTTP 200/202 SOAP Response; message mapped via Test_Mapping and generic logging headers configured
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 evaluation of Glovia_Route_SalesOrder, CallActivity_102 mapping execution, and CallActivity_13 header enrichment leading to EndEvent_2

name: Sales Order Return Processing - Route to Return Flow
trigger: Inbound SOAP request containing return order notification (e.g. OrderTypeCode POR)
expected_outcome: HTTP 200/202 SOAP Response; bypasses message mapping, logs return order headers via CallActivity_71 to EndEvent_9
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 evaluation of Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder branch and CallActivity_71 header enrichment

name: Unmatched Order Type - Default Route Escalation
trigger: Inbound SOAP request containing unrecognized OrderTypeCode not matching SalesOrder or SO Return rules
expected_outcome: SOAP 1.1 Fault returned to caller with faultstring containing Escalation and ErrorCode RoutingConditionNotMet
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 default path (SequenceFlow_110) triggering EscalationEndEvent EndEvent_11

name: Mapping Execution Failure - Exception Subprocess Handling
trigger: Inbound SOAP request with missing mandatory fields causing mapping exception during CallActivity_102
expected_outcome: Execution routed to SubProcess_91; original InputPayload restored from exchange property, logged via Log_Payload.gsh, and aborted via EndEvent_95
validates: SubProcess_91 execution, CallActivity_97 payload restoration from ${property.InputPayload}, and CallActivity_100 logging

name: Malformed XML Envelope Inbound Handling
trigger: Inbound HTTP POST containing non-parseable XML or invalid SOAP Envelope
expected_outcome: HTTP 500 SOAP Fault indicating XML parsing failure with unqualified faultcode and faultstring elements
validates: Inbound SOAP adapter validation at MessageFlow_114 and CXF robust parsing boundary
